title: BA1/1093/2006 of KAILESH SINGH Vs STATE

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARANCHAL AT NAINITAL
ORIGINAL JURISDICTION
Dated Nainital the 8th December, 2006
First Bail Application No. 1093 of 2006
Order on the bail application of the accused.
CRIMINAL SIDE
 Kailash Singh,
 S/o Sri Dilip Singh
 R/o Goal Danda,
 Reeta Sahib,
 District-Champawat. ....... Applicant in Jail.
Versus
State of Uttaranchal ..... Opposite Party
___________________________________________
In Case Crime No. 4872 of 2006
U/s 18/20 of N.D.P.S. Act,
P.S. Haldwani
District - Nainital.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Hon'ble Rajesh Tandon, J.
 The applicant has applied for bail in Case Crime No. 4872
of 2006 U/s 18/20 of N.D.P.S. Act, P.S. Haldwani, District -
Nainital.
 Heard Sri A.K. Joshi, counsel for the applicant and A.G.A.
for the State.
 A perusal of the F.I.R. shows that approximately one
kilogram opium has been recovered and in the recovery memo
no exact quantity appears to have been measured.
 Counsel for the applicant-accused has submitted that
more than one kilogram is a commercial quantity and therefore,
since no exact measurement has been taken, therefore, it will be
presumed that opium was less than one kilogram.
 Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, it is a
fit case for bail. Let the applicant be released on bail on

executing personal bond and furnishing two sureties, each of
the like amount to the satisfaction of the Magistrate concerned.
(Rajesh Tandon, J.)
Dated 08.12.2006
Rathour
